environments.notes: Tiles are 16x16. The DungeonTileSheet.java defines locations using a 1-based xy(column, row) format. For example, xy(1, 1) is the top-left tile.

terrain_features.layout_notes: Rows 0-6 cols 0-7: Traps (color 0-7 = col, shape 0-6 = row). Rows 0-4 cols 9-14: Stage 0-4 High Grass (col 9-10), Furrowed Grass (col 11-12), Short Grass (col 13-14). Row 5 cols 9-10: Embers. Row 7 cols 0-15: Plants/Spills (index + 7*16).

items.notes: items.png is 256x512 (16x32 grid of 16x16 cells). ItemSpriteSheet.java maps item constants using 1-based xy(col, row) and assignItemRect(width, height).

item_icons.notes: item_icons.png is 128x64 (16x8 grid of 8x8 mini-icons for rings, scrolls, and potions).

ghost_frames.notes: Greyscale skull/ghost death animation; identical across all armor rows. Do not tint during PPE armor swaps.
